name: toggle-switch
title: toggle-switch
description: The switch itself: a pill track whose knob slides to the end and fills with the brand colour when the bound `on` field is true. Owns its full style, references tokens only.

definition.name: toggle-switch
definition.description: The switch itself: a pill track whose knob slides to the end and fills with the brand colour when the bound `on` field is true. Owns its full style, references tokens only.
definition.whenToUse: The on/off control inside a row that supplies its own label and its own action, such as a settings row or a form's yes-or-no field. Compose via a Ref, remapping `on` to the field it reflects. A whole labelled settings row is toggle-row.
